baseline.cause: The first acquired V schedules the next field with nominal coast_period_q16. A later H frequency fit changes coast_period_q16 without correcting the already-scheduled V deadline. At +50ppm NTSC that deadline remains roughly33 input samples early, so later first-broad checks reject and repairs can touch picture.
baseline.instrumentation_scope: Counters and V scheduling prints existed only in extracted temporary baseline trees. No assertions were weakened in committed tests.

fix.description: When a qualified H fit changes coast_period_q16, adjust the pending unarmed V deadline by (new_period-old_period)*(625 PAL or525 NTSC)/2. Never move an already-armed vertical train.
